title: Pakistan's NCCIA arrests two in Lahore after overseas alerts on a college bomb threat and child sexual abuse material
date_note: The page gives only the day the agency's statement was reported; the arrest dates are not stated.
org: National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA), Pakistan
geo_basis: arrests made in Lahore, as the article states
summary: Pakistan's National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency said on Monday it arrested two people in Lahore. One is a student accused of using an AI platform to threaten to bomb a college; the platform had closed the account and alerted authorities, the agency said. The other is a man arrested after reports from the US-based NCMEC about a Google Drive account, according to Arab News Pakistan.
plain: Pakistan's cybercrime agency says it arrested two people in Lahore after tips from abroad: a student over an AI-made bomb threat against a college, and a man over child abuse material.
exec: Enforcement news only; the agency's statement, as reported by Arab News Pakistan, shows overseas platform and NCMEC reports leading to arrests in Pakistan.
impact: Officers found no explosives or weapons in the raid on the student, according to the report.

validation.note: One publisher (Arab News Pakistan) relaying the agency's statements; the agency's own statement was not read.
